title: Training-budget diagnosis for learned semantic state addressing
question: Does increasing the registered training budget materially improve the learned continuous semantic state retriever on held-out noisy codes?
hypothesis: H_budget: if the learned continuous target-state recall rises materially with training budget, the prior retrieval failure is at least partly an optimization-budget problem; if recall remains low and changes little, the current encoder/objective is likely the limiting boundary.

arms.name: no_learning_continuous
arms.intervention: random frozen dual encoder with continuous exhaustive state scoring

arms.name: learned_32
arms.intervention: same dual encoder trained for 32 epochs

arms.name: learned_128
arms.intervention: same dual encoder trained for 128 epochs

arms.name: learned_512
arms.intervention: same dual encoder trained for 512 epochs

endpoints.name: target_top1_recall
endpoints.role: primary — correct opaque persistent state selected

endpoints.name: continuous_target_rank
endpoints.role: secondary — mean rank of correct target state

endpoints.name: query_macs
endpoints.role: audit — fixed continuous query scoring arithmetic

endpoints.name: state_build_macs
endpoints.role: audit — one-time cached state embedding arithmetic

decision_rule.condition: mean learned_512 recall - mean learned_32 recall >= 0.20
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that the registered learner is materially training-budget limited on this task
decision_rule.does_not_license: that 512 epochs is optimal, or that learned semantic addressing generalizes beyond this workload

decision_rule.condition: mean learned_512 recall - mean learned_32 recall < 0.20 and mean learned_512 recall < 0.50
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that additional training budget does not remove the current low-recall boundary under this architecture/objective
decision_rule.does_not_license: that the architecture cannot be improved by a different objective, representation or negative-sampling scheme

decision_rule.condition: mean learned_512 recall >= 0.50 and mean learned_512 recall - mean learned_32 recall < 0.20
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that the current learner reaches a materially usable continuous retrieval level without a large budget effect

held_constant: same A1 H-invariant query/state stream as C5-LEARNED-STATE-001
continuous exhaustive state scoring only; binary index excluded
no evaluation address or gold target enters training
prior C5 and learned-state results remain frozen
